scope: Read-only source/test/receipt/KB audit. No Foundry launch, active-GM action, project/session/runtime mutation, provider, credential, or Technical Builder action occurred.

authorityMap.genericBatch: Foundry IR adapter emits producer.kind=foundry, reviewAuthority=foundry-runtime/gm, and targetAuthority=foundry-active-gm/requiredActiveGm=true; plan hash is the batch base hash.
authorityMap.stagedExecutor: Before dispatch it verifies the plan hash, exact approved plan hash, and approvedByUserId === activeGmUserId; the injected adapter remains the only execution boundary.
authorityMap.recovery: Unknown outcome blocks automatic retry and requires authoritative adapter reread; receipt preserves foreign state and Ready-to-Play=false.
authorityMap.separation: Generic review approval does not grant execution authority. The executor independently rechecks current active-GM identity and the exact plan hash.

fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.dependencies_source_hash_target_risk: DIRECT: Foundry IR proposal adapter maps canonical dependency order, plan target/version provider, plan SHA-256 base, document commands, and create/update risk.
fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.approve_reject_edit_cancel_stale: INDIRECT/PARTIAL: generic proposal-batch core supplies these transitions, but the staged executor has its own narrower previewed→approved→apply-ready→applying→unknown/committed/recovered journal and does not consume a generic history.
fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.active_gm_and_runtime_authority: DIRECT: generic batch declares foundry-active-gm and executor independently rejects mismatched approved/current GM identities.
fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.dispatch_reread_recovery: DIRECT DETERMINISTIC: staged executor requires exact adapter readback before commit, marks timeout/reread uncertainty unknown, and forbids automatic retry.
fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.undo_redo: MISSING FOR FOUNDRY: staged executor journal has no generic undo/redo bridge; this cannot be inferred from local Scene or project-save history.
fieldAndLifecycleMatrix.runtime_evidence: SEPARATE: Stage 9 receipts establish bounded fixture evidence but do not certify a current Stage 11 aggregate runtime execution.

conclusion: The Foundry staged-executor family already has strong deterministic conformance for hash, current-active-GM, dispatch, authoritative reread, and unknown recovery. Its missing Stage 11 bridge is narrow and non-runtime: one typed, no-write adapter must translate a completed staged-executor receipt/reread outcome into the generic proposal-batch history vocabulary without allowing generic history to dispatch, grant GM authority, or represent unimplemented undo/redo.
